findings.issue: WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE only checked body.len() >= 40 && cbSize >= 22 without verifying usize::from(cbSize) <= body.len() - 18 or checking that dwChannelMask.count_ones() <= channels.
AIFC alaw/ALAW and ulaw/ULAW accepted sampleSize values 16, 24, and 32 instead of enforcing 8 bits per sample for G.711.
